description: The bar chart titled “Factual Errors” illustrates the number of factual errors across four QA datasets for three QA methods. The horizontal axis lists the categories HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. Each dataset has a grouped set of three vertical bars corresponding to the legend: “NoR QA” shown as an orange bar with a grid-like hatch, “CoT QA” shown as a red bar with a dotted hatch, and “IRCoT QA” shown as a dark blue bar with diagonal hatching; each bar has its value annotated above it. For HotpotQA, the bars are 15 (NoR QA, orange), 10 (CoT QA, red), and 5 (IRCoT QA, blue). For 2WikiMQA, the bars are 29 (NoR QA), 23 (CoT QA), and 14 (IRCoT QA). For MuSiQue, the bars are 28 (NoR QA), 27 (CoT QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA). For IIRC, the bars are 15 (NoR QA), 14 (CoT QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). The bars are arranged in consistent method order within each dataset group, there is no indication that the dataset categories are sorted by value, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors, hatch patterns, and numeric annotations.
